title: Skin Care for Lack of Sleep: Night and Morning Fixes
ex: A realistic routine for late nights: a 5-minute night routine, a morning fix for puffy eyes and dull skin, which night cream suits tired skin, and habits that help.
rt: Skin Care for Lack of Sleep: Night & Morning Fixes | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for lack of sleep: a 5-minute night routine, a morning fix for puffy eyes and dull-looking skin, and simple habits for tired Indian skin.
keyword: skin care for lack of sleep
quick: After a short night, splash with cool water, use a cold compress on puffy eyes, apply a light moisturiser and sunscreen. At night, never skip cleansing and a pea-sized amount of night cream, however late it is. Creams help skin look less tired but cannot replace sleep.
facts: Cleanse and moisturise even on very late nights
Cool water and a chilled cloth help morning puffiness
Skip new products and scrubs when very tired
Change pillow covers at least twice a week
